$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-SEV-003 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §9.4 and the RF-SEV-003 inventory entry. Clinical-content-only rule: cites evidence claims and has NO architecture references (architecture_refs intentionally empty per v1.2 §4.3). Expresses documented central-aponeurosis location / uncertainty-widening STRUCTURE only: a DOCUMENTED proximal central-aponeurosis involvement may widen prognostic caution vs distal in a similar high-level soccer population. It is never inferred from mechanism/pain/symptoms/self-tests/raw imaging, never becomes an autonomous prognosis engine, fixed timeline, deterministic formula/score, phase change, or dosing change. No diagnosis, rehab, dosage, progression, confidence, or return-to-sport logic; safety precedence preserved. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.

input_contract.$comment: Structural location input taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §9.4. Central-aponeurosis location is used only when documented by an acceptable source; it is never inferred and raw media is never interpreted here.

decision_contract.$comment: Documented-location uncertainty/context structure only. A documented proximal central-aponeurosis location may widen guarded prognostic caution; it does not become an autonomous prognosis engine, fixed timeline, deterministic formula/score, phase change, or dosing change, and does not assign confidence/probability. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Clinical_content normative source; MAY; permitted_use logic_with_uncertainty. Architecture references are intentionally empty: per v1.2 §4.3 clinical-content rules cite valid evidence_claim_ids and do not carry architecture refs (none in §9.4); [] means 'none in source', not 'missing'. Evidence grades/roles preserved per source: QRF-008 (D2; central-tendon context), QRF-010 (D2; proximal-versus-distal location context). Per §9.4 logic: documented proximal central-aponeurosis involvement may increase prognostic caution compared with distal involvement in a similar high-level soccer population. Per §9.4 action: widen uncertainty and avoid early date promises; do NOT automatically alter stage or dosing. Per §9.4 prohibited use preserved exactly: no deterministic return-date formula. Central-aponeurosis location is used only when documented by an acceptable external report, verified assessment, or source explicitly permitted by v1.2; it is never inferred from mechanism, pain location, symptoms, self-tests, or raw imaging. Raw media (MRI/ultrasound/DICOM/screenshots/image files/photos/videos) is not interpreted here and requires a separately validated imaging subsystem (V3.1 §25). Cohort medians/benchmarks remain group context only, never an individual prediction; the rule does not create a deterministic severity or recurrence score, assign confidence/probability, determine rehab phase, authorize rehab, produce a complete plan, or produce a return-to-sport decision, and does not override safety, current capacity, external restrictions, stage, readiness, or concurrent-injury constraints. Uncertainty is preserved when the source is weak, absent, user-entered without source, unclear, non-specific, or not documented as required. Prognosis rule, not a safety rule, so safety_state_output is null and blocked_targets is empty; safety precedence preserved. No severity/prognosis model is authored here (deferred to the later severity and readiness objects). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
